meta.title: Changing the status of a bid that does not exist
gaps: The exact PATCH /bids/update_bid_status request and buyer actor are not available as a vocabulary operation; the closest library case tests refusal of a non-existent bid through a different bid-status path.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid not found”, and never with a server error.
